svg.title: Nonlinearity makes depth useful
svg.desc: Composing linear maps without nonlinear activations is equivalent to one linear map. Nonlinear activations increase expressiveness but their gradients can saturate or die.

g.text: Without an activation, stacked linear layers collapse into one matrix multiplication.
Useful activations also need useful gradients: sigmoid/tanh saturate; ReLU can die for negative inputs.
